rulesets.c: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D game art: clean smooth dark linework, muted desaturated palette, soft painterly cel shading, bug-like chibi proportions, melancholic fairy-tale tone. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-rendered. A GAME UI FRAME only, dark decorative Hollow Knight style, ornate but quiet, muted gold-on-charcoal filigree, empty center so text can sit inside. No letters, no numbers. Opaque artwork, NOT magenta.
